params.name: fields
params.description: Fields requested in the returned resource

params.name: database
params.description: Filter tables by database fully qualified name

params.name: databaseSchema
params.description: Filter tables by databaseSchema fully qualified name

params.name: databaseSchemaRegex
params.description: Filter tables by database schema regex pattern applied to databaseSchema.name by default. To apply the regex to the fully qualified name, set regexFilterByFqn=true. For better performance, use this in combination with the database query filter.

params.name: tableRegex
params.description: Filter tables by table regex pattern applied to the table name by default. To apply the regex to the table fully qualified name, set regexFilterByFqn=true. For better performance, use this in combination with the database and/or databaseSchema query filters.

params.name: includeEmptyTestSuite
params.description: Include tables with an empty test suite (i.e. no test cases have been created for this table). Default to true

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number tables returned. (1 to 1000000, default = 10)

params.name: before
params.description: Returns list of tables before this cursor

params.name: after
params.description: Returns list of tables after this cursor

params.name: include
params.description: Include all, deleted, or non-deleted entities.

params.name: regexFilterByFqn
params.description: When true, regex filters match against fullyQualifiedName instead of name. Default is false.

params.name: regexMode
params.description: Controls how regex filters are applied. 'include' returns matching entities, 'exclude' returns non-matching entities. Default is 'include'.

items.docs: Get a list of tables, optionally filtered by `database` it belongs to. Use `fields` parameter to get only necessary fields. Use cursor-based pagination to limit the number entries in the list using `limit` and `before` or `after` query params.
Create a new table under an existing `database`.
Create a table, if it does not exist. If a table already exists, update the table.
